text: First click into Notepad, then click back into THIS window. Now hold  j  with your right hand. While holding it, press Alt+Tab with your left hand and let go of Alt and Tab, so Notepad comes forward. Then let go of  j . Then Alt+Tab back to THIS window.
Alt+Tab to Notepad. In Notepad, hold  j . While holding it, Alt+Tab back to THIS window and let go of Alt and Tab. Then let go of  j  here.
Lower-case L (the key right of K), no Shift: press it, let go, press it again.
Lower-case L, no Shift: press it and hold about 1.5 seconds, then let go.
Drum  a s d f  with the four fingers of your left hand, quickly, six or seven times. Order does not matter; keys overlapping is the point.
